ideas.title: Idea Workbench
ideas.subtitle: Write down an idea. The AI only asks questions; the thinking is yours. Once it's clear, turn it into a project and start finding teammates.
ideas.ideaPlaceholder: For example: a tool that helps grad students find collaborators in other fields, because our medical imaging group never has anyone who knows the clinical side…
ideas.answerRule: Answer every question in your own words to continue.
ideas.agentPrompt: Kickoff prompt for other AI agents
ideas.publishNote: Only the direction and the roles you need are public. The AI will suggest candidates for you.
ideas.examplesTitle: Not sure where to start? Try one of these:
examples: A tool that helps grad students find collaborators in other fields, because our medical imaging group never has anyone who knows the clinical side.
A campus app where seniors pass their used textbooks to juniors in the same course, because tons of books are thrown away every semester.
A lightweight follow-up tracker for community doctors, since they still track hypertension patients with phone calls and spreadsheets.
A study-habit experiment that tests which anti-procrastination method actually works for college students.
ideas.noDrafts: Your ideas are saved here automatically as you work.

ideas.progressHint: Answer more rounds to cover more angles before shaping it.

ideas.previewTitle: This is what people will see
ideas.previewNote: Only the title, one-liner, problem, target users, next steps and roles are public. Your answers and the agent prompt stay private.
ideas.becameProjectHint: Update the brief and roles in the project from here on. This page keeps the version you published and your thinking record.
